=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
Requirement: CLAUDE.md §20 ("One fragment per PR. Never reuse another PR's filename.") and §20.B ("`scripts/assemble_changelog.py` folds fragments into `CHANGELOG.md`"); §20 also requires `.ai/.workspace_source_manifest.txt` to track the actual changelog fragments the PR ships.
Expected change site: `changelog.d/` (one fragment only) and `.ai/.workspace_source_manifest.txt` (the line list near 204-210).
Evidence of absence: The PR ships two fragments that describe the same merged-PR guard parser fix — `changelog.d/6321-merge-guard-empty-quote-fd.md:1-6` (`<!-- changelog: fixed -->`) and `changelog.d/6333-quoted-numeric-refspec-fd-guard.md:1-2` (`<!-- changelog: security -->`). Both fragments document the identical observable change (quoted/escaped numeric branch refspecs now receive the guard check; ordinary unquoted FD redirects still work). The plan now explicitly states this PR ships an observable merged-PR guard fix and "requires a changelog fragment" (singular), so two fragments contradict the plan's own statement. Separately, `.ai/.workspace_source_manifest.txt:207` lists `changelog.d/6133-pr-merge-guard-live-copy-sync.md`, but no file by that name exists in the PR diff or the working tree (the closest match is `changelog.d/6133-pr-merge-guard-live-copy-sync.md` already in the tree from an earlier PR — the manifest entry pre-dates this PR's fix and is unrelated). The two fragments the PR actually adds (6321, 6333) are not recorded in the manifest at all, so the auto-generated inventory drifts from what the PR ships. On the next release, `scripts/assemble_changelog.py` will fold both fragments into `CHANGELOG.md`, producing two adjacent entries for one behavior change and violating the one-fragment-per-PR contract that prevents merge conflicts under concurrent PRs.
SEVERITY: MAJOR
ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
